gate_policies.name: No docker exec
gate_policies.reason: Container internals are not inspected through shell/exec.

gate_policies.name: No package creation
gate_policies.reason: Packaging remains paused until execution scope and proof gates close.

gate_policies.name: Backup/rollback containers are document-only
gate_policies.reason: Backup/rollback cannot become primary active authority.

gate_policies.name: High-risk containers require explicit scope gate
gate_policies.reason: High-risk surfaces must be narrowed into an active execution scope before any later approval.

remaining_gates.description: Select and lock the exact minimal runtime scope from the container gate matrix.
Owner approval must be constrained to the locked active scope.
Any later execution proof must be single-use and receipt-bound.
Packaging remains blocked until runtime proof is complete.

next_phase_needs: 441 must lock a minimal active execution scope.
441 must choose from execution-critical candidates only.
441 must keep support-only containers outside active scope unless required.
441 must not execute or mutate Docker.
441 must preserve Device Layer authority boundary.
